logp.method_description: The shake-flask method was used to determine the lipophilicity of the stable 99mTc complexes. Briefly, 50 μL (∼74 kBq) of the isolated complex was added to a centrifuge tube containing 3 mL of 1-octanol/PBS:1/1 (0.1 M, pH 7.4). After 1 min vortex at room temperature, the mixture was centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 5 min. The radioactivity of three aliquots (3 × 0.1 mL) from 1-octanol and PBS phases was counted in a gamma counter. Octanol aliquot of 0.5 mL was subsequently repartitioned until constant values were obtained. The measurement was repeated three times. The Do/w values were calculated by dividing the counts in the 1-octanol by those in the PBS aliquots [9].
